project.description: Oxide project where machines will be created.

cpus.description: Number of vCPUs to assign to the machine.

memory.description: Amount of memory to assign to the instance, in gibibytes.

disks.description: Additional disks to attach to the machine. Each disk is created blank and attached at instance creation time.

type.description: Backend type for the data disk. 'distributed' creates a Crucible-backed disk; 'local' creates a sled-local disk.

network_interfaces.description: Network interfaces to attach to the machine.

ip_config.description: IP configuration for the network interface.

subnet_name.description: Name of the subnet to use for the network interface.

vpc_name.description: Name of the VPC to use for the network interface.

auto_restart_policy.description: Auto restart policy for the machine.

anti_affinity_groups.description: Anti-affinity groups to place the machine in.
